aboutWhatItDoes: HealthYarn dey allow you ask everyday health question for Yorùbá, Nigerian Pidgin, or English and hear general health guide with Nigerian voice — e dey check confirmed guides first, and e get safe guardrailed general guide for valid health question wey no dey inside the main list.
aboutWhatItDoesNot: HealthYarn no dey diagnose sickness, prescribe medicine, or calculate personal dose. For any emergency or danger sign, go hospital straight.
aboutPrivacySummary: No account for public users. No tracking cookies. Voice recording dey stay only for RAM sharp-sharp and e dey delete immediately.

problemHeading: Health advice no suppose need big English.
problemBody: Doctors no plenty and dem dey busy well-well. Paper and medicine pack dey always carry English. So many people dey wait too long, take drug wrong way, or follow wetin neighbour talk. HealthYarn give everybody person wey dem fit ask.

step1Body: Press Yoruba, Pidgin or English. The app go talk guide you.
step2Body: Hold the mic talk your question, like "My pikin dey stool since yesterday. Wetin I go do?" Or just press picture.
step3Body: Nigerian voice go answer you for your language. You fit play am again or slow am down anytime.
safetyBody: HealthYarn no dey diagnose sickness, prescribe medicine, or tell you personal dose. Main answers come from World Health Organization and Federal Ministry of Health guide wey health workers and native speakers check. For valid health question outside the main list, AI general guide dey carry clear label and e go direct you go clinic. If wetin you ask no be health matter or e no clear, e no go guess.
safetyBodyUnreviewed: For dis preview version, the voice guide dey work well while health worker and language review still dey under final check.
safetyWill1: explain common sickness with simple words
safetyWill2: tell you when to run go clinic sharp-sharp
safetyWill3: show you how to take drug safely
safetyWillNot1: check your body or talk which sickness you get
safetyWillNot2: write drug or dose for you
safetyWillNot3: replace your doctor, nurse or pharmacist
dangerCalloutBody: If wetin you talk sound serious, HealthYarn go stop tell you make you go clinic now-now, and e go show you clinics near you.

aboutSec1Lead: Better health information no suppose depend on how well you sabi read English.
aboutSec2Body: For plenty Nigerian house, person wey dey take care of sick pikin or mama and papa wey don old dey talk Pidgin or Yoruba every day, but hospital paper, medicine label, and health advert dey inside big English. Doctors small and dem busy well-well, so time no always dey to ask question. We build HealthYarn so anybody fit ask health question the way dem go ask trusted neighbour, talk am loud for their own words, and hear answer wey dem understand and fit trust.
aboutSec2Quote: If you fit send voice note, you fit use HealthYarn.
aboutSec3Title: Every answer dey pass through real people hand before e reach you.
aboutSec3Step1: Dem write am for simple English from World Health Organization and Nigeria Federal Ministry of Health guide
aboutSec3Step2: Doctor, nurse or pharmacist check am confirm
aboutSec3Step2Demo: Demo mode still dey wait for clinical review confirm
aboutSec3Step3: Dem translate am enter Pidgin and Yoruba, native speakers check am well
aboutSec3Step3Demo: Pidgin and Yoruba translation still dey wait for native-speaker final check
aboutSec3Step4: Dem record voice and listen to am again before e go live.
aboutSec3Note: Confirmed answers come straight from our clinician-checked guide library with Verified badge. If valid health question no dey inside the main list, HealthYarn dey give clear-labelled guardrailed general info without diagnosing or prescribing drug.
aboutSec3NoteDemo: Dis demo preview dey combine core health guides with clearly badged guardrailed AI general health info for extra questions. E no dey diagnose, write medicine, or replace clinic.
